verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line claiming "Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts" (meltano-docs-13). Scheduled pipelines are documented via Airflow orchestration (meltano-docs-7), which gives an expected cadence that alerts could be checked against. Nothing shows per-destination-table freshness visibility or alerts that fire specifically when a scheduled run is missed. Missing for 10: per-table freshness tracking or display, documented missed-cadence/SLA alerting, in-depth docs on how monitoring and alerts work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
